title: warn.t1 shifted 300 ticks (1201-1500) in 121d8a0 but the change-log's re-bless scope omits it and claims 'everything else byte-identical'
evidence:
spec change-log: "  no intent gaps, no bad specs. Re-bless scope this round: qos T1/log/PNGs, warn 65s PNG, surge PNGs +
  one new capture — all cause-documented; everything else byte-identical."
git diff f906725 121d8a0 --stat: " goldens/warn.t1 | 600 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++----------------------------" (300 insertions, 300 deletions)
goldens/warn.t1 diff hunk: "@@ -1205,303 +1205,303 @@ ticks 1500" with "-1201 6308b68800590d4a" -> "+1201 aa9be8ef99ff3278" (changed ticks 1201 through 1500).
detail: The W-qos resolve-margin change altered warn.dem's crisis lifecycle post-trigger (hash at 1200 unchanged, 1201-1500 all differ), but the re-bless scope lists only 'warn 65s PNG'. The scope line also claims 'qos ... log' re-blessed while goldens/qos.log.bin is unchanged in this commit.
recommended_fix: Disclose goldens/warn.t1 in the re-bless scope with the cause (the W-qos lane-margin change shifts warn.dem's crisis stream exactly like qos.dem's), and drop 'log' from the qos listing or re-bless it.

title: N4 restructure lets the (c) pool backstop fire the same tick (a)/(b) already triggered — two active crises + two Crisis_Triggered for one (archetype, set-piece) activation
detail: crisis_active_for is checked before (a) appends its row; a successful (a) trigger now falls through and (c) appends a second row + second Crisis_Triggered. The old code's post-trigger `continue` prevented this. Breach of 'at most one crisis per activation'.
recommended_fix: Re-check crisis_active_for(state, ai, u16(si)) inside the (c) block before triggering (or `continue` after a successful (a)/(b) trigger while keeping the cooldown-blocked fall-through N4 requires).

title: STILL-PRESENT: types.odin Event comment still ends with 'pre-3.3/3.4/4.1/4.2 event streams stay byte-identical' — the exact claim the +4B drop-payload fold makes false
detail: The r2 W3 close-condition was to amend types.odin to serialize.odin's wording; the fold admission was added, but the contradictory tail sentence (pre-4.2 streams stay byte-identical) remains verbatim in the same comment. Contradicts serialize.odin:385-387.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the types.odin tail sentence to match serialize.odin, e.g. 'tag-conditional writing keeps unchanged-tag payloads byte-identical except the documented Packet_Dropped fold'.
